profiled_fields: server CPU seconds and one-core percentage
outer AgentApi fabric mutex wait total/count
server process OS read/write byte deltas
client-observed p50/p95/p99 per operation and scenario
allocation_measurement: Separate tracemalloc run for each concurrency/trial; same operation count; excluded from latency and throughput results.

verification.lint: Ruff passed for profiler, API, and focused test files.
verification.pytest_command: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_api.py tests/test_stage_trace.py tests/test_p12b_api_load.py tests/test_p12b_harness.py --junitxml=research/results/e4-03-profile-tests.xml -q

limitations: Three trials per concurrency point on one Windows host are operational evidence, not a production capacity guarantee.
OS I/O counters can omit cached writes; RSS is sampled every 10 ms and may miss brief peaks.
SQLite uses a single local server process; this is not a multi-host benchmark.
